title: Belfry Battery vs Flamewrought Company
lede: Flamewrought Company beat Belfry Battery 34-11 on Victory Points in Battle Round 4, holding the 3 VP centre every round and destroying nine of the Covenant's units for the loss of two. Belfry Battery's guns had nothing in front of them: once Javidan Immortals 1 and Ardashir broke the Archistrategos's Knight-Apostle Squad in Round 2, the Sagdid Hound-Keepers and Shieldbearers walked onto every objective.
result_line: Flamewrought Company win 34-11 on Victory Points in Battle Round 4
deployment:
Belfry Battery (Player A, initiative, south edge, 247 RP) is a gun line: the Nicomedean Thunder Tower at (3,12), St. Barbara Field Guns at (5,12) and (9,14), a Master Gunner and a Petard Bearer, screened by the Archistrategos with a Knight-Apostle Squad at (4,12) and two Covenant Levies, the first led by a Cantor-Preceptor at (7,12). Flamewrought Company (Player B, north edge, 249 RP) brought eleven units: Ardashir - The Flamebringer with Javidan Immortals 1 at (5,2), Javidan Immortals 2 at (9,2), the Mobad with Shieldbearers 1 at (3,2), Shieldbearers 2, two Adur Furnace Guard and three Sagdid Hound-Keepers.

Belfry Battery's Primary, ERADICATE THE FOE, needs enemy units destroyed inside Objective Areas, so it wants the enemy to come to its guns. Flamewrought Company's BREAK THEIR HOLD pays for taking ground the Covenant holds, and it had the numbers to stand on all three objectives at once.

1.title: A requisitioned squad burns in its first round

feed.text: Belfry Battery spent all 3 CP on Troop Requisition for a third Covenant Levies at (8,12) and kept INTO THE FRAY. Flamewrought Company gave Adur Furnace Guard 1 Double Time (2 CP) and Sagdid Hound-Keepers 1 a Scouting Order (1 CP, bought nothing), and passed on both mission cards it drew (FORWARD DEPLOYMENT and COMMAND AUTHORITY).

Javidan Immortals 1 with Ardashir (6,6) and Javidan Immortals 2 (7,6) took the centre; Sagdid Hound-Keepers 2 ran onto the west objective at (2,6). The requisitioned Covenant Levies went straight to (7,8), Covenant Levies 1 and the Cantor-Preceptor to (6,8), the Petard Bearer to the east objective at (12,8).

Adur Furnace Guard 1, two squares further forward thanks to Double Time, shot the requisitioned Covenant Levies for 14 and its BURNED finished the squad (6 more). Sagdid Hound-Keepers 3 put 1 into the Petard Bearer.
Flamewrought Company won the centre on OC 25 against 12 (3 VP) and the west (2); the Petard Bearer held the east alone (2). 2-5.

2.title: The Archistrategos swings first and loses the exchange

feed.text: Flamewrought Company's 3 CP Secure Objective on Javidan Immortals 1 decided nothing. Both sides kept VIGILANT WATCH.

Overwatch completed both VIGILANT WATCH cards: Sagdid Hound-Keepers 2 hit Covenant Levies 2 for 1 and the Master Gunner hit Sagdid Hound-Keepers 3 for 2. The Petard Bearer charged Sagdid Hound-Keepers 3 at (13,6) for INTO THE FRAY (+2). Javidan Immortals 1 and Ardashir charged the Archistrategos, the Knight-Apostle Squad, Covenant Levies 1 and the Cantor-Preceptor at (6,7) (a 1 CP Go to Ground covered the Knight-Apostles from Ardashir's Overwatch); Covenant Levies 1 broke away in disorder to (9,9). Javidan Immortals 2 charged at (9,8) and the Master Gunner fell back to (5,9).

The Archistrategos used Quis ut Deus? and attacked Ardashir, but Javidan Immortals 1 (INI 9 with the charge bonus) struck first for 4 on the Knight-Apostle Squad, Ardashir's counterattack added 4 more and set both BURNED, and the Archistrategos's 3 hits went into Javidan Immortals 1. The Knight-Apostle Squad added 3. Covenant Levies 2 shot Sagdid Hound-Keepers 2 dead (6) on the west objective. Javidan Immortals 2 took 13 off Covenant Levies 1. BURNED then took 2 each off the Archistrategos and the Knight-Apostle Squad.

Belfry Battery 7: the west (2), ERADICATE THE FOE 2, INTO THE FRAY 2, VIGILANT WATCH 1, for 9. Flamewrought Company 9: centre 3, the east (2, Sagdid Hound-Keepers 3 on OC 2 against 1), BREAK THEIR HOLD 3 for the east it took off the Covenant and VIGILANT WATCH 1, for 14.

3.title: Belfry Battery walks off the west and loses its guns

feed.text: Flamewrought Company requisitioned Sagdid Hound-Keepers at (9,2) for 3 CP. Belfry Battery spent 5 CP on Covenant Levies 2, which was standing on the west objective: Secure Objective (3) and Double Time (2). Then, in the Movement Phase, it moved Covenant Levies 2 from (2,8) to (7,9), out of every Objective Area.

The Knight-Apostle Squad, down to 2 HP, failed its Fall Back test and was destroyed by the 3 True Damage of breaking away in disorder; the Archistrategos fell back to (5,10) on 3 more. Shieldbearers 1 and the Mobad walked onto the empty west objective at (1,6). Overwatch from Shieldbearers 2 put 6 into the Nicomedean Thunder Tower and Shieldbearers 1 and Sagdid Hound-Keepers 1 put 4 into St. Barbara Field Gun 1. Javidan Immortals 2 charged the Archistrategos and Covenant Levies 2 at (8,9).

Shieldbearers 1 (3) and Shieldbearers 2 (3) finished the Nicomedean Thunder Tower; Sagdid Hound-Keepers 1 finished St. Barbara Field Gun 1. Javidan Immortals 2 took 13 off Covenant Levies 2. The Master Gunner put 4 into Shieldbearers 2 and St. Barbara Field Gun 1's BURNED took 2 off Shieldbearers 1. The Cantor-Preceptor cast Gloria (4 Mana) on St. Barbara Field Gun 2, which then missed; the Mobad's Ember of Atar (3 Mana) bought nothing.

Flamewrought Company took the centre (3) and the west (2, OC 7 against 0), BREAK THEIR HOLD 3 for the flipped west and DEEP REACH 2 (1 more withheld by the 10 VP cap): 10 for 24. The east tied on OC 1 against 1. Belfry Battery scored nothing. 9-24.

Benediction healed the Archistrategos for 5 and Belfry Battery requisitioned Covenant Levies #2 (3 CP). Flamewrought Company gave Adur Furnace Guard 1 Double Time (2 CP) and kept TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET.

Adur Furnace Guard 1 ran to (8,8), and its Overwatch destroyed Covenant Levies 1 (3) when the Levies moved. Covenant Levies 2 and the Master Gunner both broke away in disorder. Shieldbearers 2 stepped onto the centre at (7,7), Sagdid Hound-Keepers 1 onto the west at (2,8), the requisitioned Sagdid Hound-Keepers onto the east at (12,8), and Javidan Immortals 1 and Ardashir charged the Cantor-Preceptor at (7,9).

The Petard Bearer destroyed Sagdid Hound-Keepers 3 (2) inside the east Objective Area, Belfry Battery's second and last kill. Shieldbearers 1 destroyed St. Barbara Field Gun 2 (5). Javidan Immortals 1 killed the Cantor-Preceptor (4); Reprieve brought it back at 2 HP, it cast Kyrie on the Archistrategos, and Ardashir killed it again. The requisitioned Sagdid Hound-Keepers shot the Petard Bearer dead (3) and Sagdid Hound-Keepers 1 destroyed Covenant Levies 2 (4).

Flamewrought Company held all three objectives (7) and TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET (3): 10 for 34. Belfry Battery's ERADICATE THE FOE paid 2 for 11. Of its starting army only the Archistrategos and the Master Gunner were left, beside the newly requisitioned Covenant Levies #2.

analysis.title: Why it went this way
analysis.html:
Where the VP came from

Flamewrought Company's 34: objectives 22 (the centre in all four rounds is 12 of them), BREAK THEIR HOLD 6 (3 in Round 2 for the east, 3 in Round 3 for the west) and secondaries 6 (TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET 3, DEEP REACH 2, VIGILANT WATCH 1). Belfry Battery's 11: objectives 4 (the east in Round 1, the west in Round 2), ERADICATE THE FOE 4 and secondaries 3 (INTO THE FRAY 2, VIGILANT WATCH 1). Belfry Battery never held the centre and held nothing after Round 2.

{{chart:objectives}}

What the key units did

Flamewrought Company's damage was spread over cheap units. Javidan Immortals 2 (30 RP) did the most damage, 26, all of it into Covenant Levies. Adur Furnace Guard 1 (20 RP) did 23 and destroyed two Levies squads, one in the round it was requisitioned and one with Overwatch. The two Shieldbearers squads (17 RP each) killed the Nicomedean Thunder Tower and St. Barbara Field Gun 2, and Sagdid Hound-Keepers 1 (10 RP) finished St. Barbara Field Gun 1 and Covenant Levies 2. The 10 RP Sagdid Hound-Keepers squads scored 5 VP each: Sagdid Hound-Keepers 3 for the east and BREAK THEIR HOLD in Round 2, the requisitioned one for the east and TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET in Round 4. In all it destroyed 177 of Belfry Battery's 267 RP.

Belfry Battery's best unit was the 15 RP Petard Bearer: 6 VP from the east objective, INTO THE FRAY and the Round 4 kill. The gun line it was built around dealt 16 damage before it died (Master Gunner 6, St. Barbara Field Gun 1 6, Nicomedean Thunder Tower 4, St. Barbara Field Gun 2 nothing). The Archistrategos did 3 damage all battle: his Round 2 Quis ut Deus? attack hit Javidan Immortals 1 instead of Ardashir after the Immortals struck first, and the exchange cost him two Knight-Apostles and set his pair BURNED.

{{chart:rp-trade}}

The army or the AI?

Both. The army is a gun line with a thin screen, facing eleven units that could stand on three objectives and still put two Javidan squads into its screen. Its guns are slow to bring to bear (the St. Barbara Field Guns were idle with no worthwhile action in Round 1 and spent Rounds 2 to 4 under fire) and fragile (5 HP each).

Two AI decisions made it worse. In Round 3 Belfry Battery spent 5 CP on Secure Objective and Double Time for Covenant Levies 2 while it stood on the west objective, then used the Double Time to walk it off the objective to (7,9), where Javidan Immortals 2 charged it. Shieldbearers 1 took the empty west on OC 7 against 0, which was 2 VP for the objective and 3 for BREAK THEIR HOLD. In the same Movement Phase the Knight-Apostle Squad, on 2 HP, tried to Fall Back from Javidan Immortals 1, failed the test, and the 3 True Damage of breaking away destroyed it; the Fall Back record calls it doubtful (4.42 expected melee damage against the pair's 10 HP). The Round 1 Troop Requisition (3 CP) went straight to (7,8) in front of the enemy and burned to death that round, and Flamewrought Company's Secure Objective in Round 2 and Scouting Order in Round 1 bought nothing.

{{chart:attrition}}

Against the first playing

The first playing ended the same way, Flamewrought Company 36-11 in Round 4. The presets moved: Belfry Battery gained a Cantor-Preceptor and a cheaper gun line (Nicomedean Thunder Tower 35 RP, was 45; St. Barbara Field Guns 23 and 18, were 30 and 25), Ardashir fell to 65 RP (was 75) and Flamewrought Company added Sagdid Hound-Keepers 3. In the first playing the Archistrategos destroyed the Mobad and Shieldbearers 1 in Round 2 for a 3 VP ERADICATE THE FOE; this time his attack went into Javidan Immortals 1 and the card paid 2 twice. Flamewrought Company's last round was 13 VP in the first playing; here the cap held its Round 3 to 10 (1 VP of DEEP REACH withheld) and Round 4 came to exactly 10.

closing: Flamewrought Company did not need a big fight. It put cheap units on every objective, let Javidan Immortals grind the Covenant Levies, and picked off the guns from range. Belfry Battery's screen broke in Round 2, and in Round 3 the AI walked its last objective holder away. Two kills in four rounds is not enough for an army whose Primary is ERADICATE THE FOE.
